title: 第一卷 第15章 想学啊？我教你啊！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
修为灌顶，一股强悍的力量，自姜无痕体内爆发。

    只在眨眼间，他便冲破了天武境的桎梏，晋升洞天境！

    而这，仅仅只是开始！

    下一刻，他的修为气息，开始极速攀升——

    洞天境第二重！

    洞天境第三重！

    ……

    洞天境第九重！

    突破！

    化龙境境第一重！

    ……

    眨眼间，姜无痕的修为达到了化龙境第九重巅峰。

    几乎是同时，他一把抓住勒在自己脖子上的那条胳膊，出乎预料的又细又软。

    “给我，放开！”

    姜无痕手腕发力，直接将对方甩了出去。

    一道衣着粉嫩的身影在地上滚了两圈，立刻站了起来。

    他这才看清对方——

    不是别人，正是沐凝薇！

    “凝薇？大清早的，你发什么疯！”

    姜无痕皱眉道。

    也得亏是她，其他人如果敢偷袭姜家帝子，雪姨和那十几位圣人级别的护道者，早就动手了！

    沐凝薇眼眶红红的，眼角还挂着泪痕，一脸倔强道：“我才没有发疯，你是坏人，我要教训你这个大骗子！”

    说完，她纵身一跃，再度攻向姜无痕。

    洞天境第九重的修为尽显！

    这个修为并不算高，但当双方正面交锋时，姜无痕却被她一记小粉拳震退。

    这时，他才反应过来，这看似弱不禁风的小丫头片子，实则是先天战体！

    香香软软的泥头车啊！

    姜无痕甩了甩又疼又麻的手腕，无奈笑道：“我干什么了？怎么就成坏人和大骗子了？”

    “你，你欺负我娘亲！”

    沐凝薇轻咬粉唇，美眸中有泪花打转：“昨晚，我清清楚楚的听到……我娘亲分明都向你求饶了，可你还是打了她整整一夜……”

    姜无尘一阵哑然，合着你听了一晚上的墙角是吧？

    那昨晚自己和沐云溪说的那些虎狼之词，是不是也都被她给听到了？
content_en:
After the cultivation initiation, a powerful force burst out from Jiang Wuhen's body.

    In just the blink of an eye, he broke through the shackles of the Tianwu realm and was promoted to the Cave Heaven realm!

    And this is just the beginning!

    The next moment, his cultivation aura began to rise rapidly——

    The second level of Cave Heaven Realm!

    The third level of Cave Heaven Realm!

    …

    The ninth level of Cave Heaven Realm!

    breakthrough!

    The first level of Dragon Transformation Realm!

    …

    In the blink of an eye, Jiang Wuhen's cultivation reached the peak of the ninth level of the Dragon Transformation Realm.

    Almost at the same time, he grabbed the arm around his neck, which was unexpectedly thin and soft.

    "Give it to me, let go!"

    Jiang Wuhen exerted force on his wrist and threw the opponent directly away.

    A figure in pink clothes rolled twice on the ground and stood up immediately.

    Only then did he see the other person clearly——

    It was none other than Mu Ningwei!

    "Ningwei? Why are you so crazy so early in the morning!"

    Jiang Wuhen frowned.

    Thanks to her, if others dared to sneak attack on the Jiang family's emperor, Aunt Xue and those dozen saint-level protectors would have done it long ago!

    Mu Ningwei's eyes were red, with tears still hanging from the corners of her eyes, and she said with a stubborn face: "I'm not crazy, you are a bad person, I want to teach you a lesson, you're a big liar!"

    After saying that, she jumped up and attacked Jiang Wuhen again.

    The cultivation of the ninth level of Cave Heaven Realm is fully displayed!

    This level of cultivation is not high, but when the two sides faced off, Jiang Wuhen was knocked back by her small pink fist.

    Only then did he realize that this seemingly frail little girl was actually an innate warrior!

    A fragrant and soft dump truck!

    Jiang Wuhen shook his painful and numb wrist and said with a helpless smile: "What did I do? How did I become a bad guy and a big liar?"

    "You, you bully my mother!"

    Mu Ningwei bit her pink lips lightly, tears welling up in her beautiful eyes: "Last night, I heard clearly...my mother clearly begged you for mercy, but you still beat her all night long..."

    Jiang Wuchen was speechless for a while, listening to you all night in the corner, right?

    Then did she also hear all those tiger and wolf words she and Mu Yunxi said last night?
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 15 Want to learn? Let me teach you!
